en_before: Compared with Fairycore, fairy grunge often reduces bright pastels, fresh florals and pristine effects in favor of earthy brown, moss green, smoky grey and faded black. Compared with conventional Grunge , it retains movement through sheer fabric, lace, asymmetric skirts or organic details. The same combat boots can suggest grunge with flannel and ripped jeans, or fairy grunge beside soft skirts and thin textures.
